# Building Scout

> Building Scout is a free book by Christopher Haworth: a plain-English guide to AI agents, and the tools that build them. Readers with no coding experience use Claude Code to build Scout, a working AI research assistant made of a team of AI agents, and put it live on the internet. The book is free to download as a PDF and an EPUB from {{SITE}}/.

Key facts:

- Full title: Building Scout: A plain-English guide to AI agents, and the tools that build them
- Author: Christopher Haworth (Chris Haworth), a product leader in SaaS and digital communications, not a developer (he started out dabbling in front-end HTML, CSS, PHP and JavaScript): https://www.linkedin.com/in/chris-haworth-98605b27/
- Price: free, as a PDF and an EPUB, in exchange for a name and email address
- Language: British English
- Length: fifteen chapters in five parts, plus five appendices
- Audience: complete beginners, and people who keep hearing about "agents" and "MCP" at work and want to understand them by building something real
- Topics: AI agents, Claude Code, prompts, tools, hooks, subagents, skills, MCP (the Model Context Protocol), LangGraph, long-running harnesses and autoresearch
- What you build: Scout, an AI research assistant. A planner agent splits a question into tasks, researcher agents search the web in parallel, a writer produces a Markdown report in which every claim cites its source, and a fact-checker reviews it. Built with Python, FastAPI, LangGraph and the Claude API.
- Independent: not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic.

## The book

- [Get the book free]({{SITE}}/#free): download the PDF and EPUB

## Contents

Part One: Foundations
1. What an agent actually is
2. Setting up your workshop
3. Talking to Claude well

Part Two: Working with Claude Code
4. Building with Claude Code
5. Giving Claude a memory
6. Checks that can say no

Part Three: Building the agent
7. Writing tools for agents
8. A team of researchers
9. Drawing the map

Part Four: Scaling your workshop
10. Helpers with their own desks
11. Teaching Claude your recipes
12. Plugging into the world

Part Five: Running on its own
13. Work that outlasts a conversation
14. The agent in a loop
15. Shipping Scout

Appendices: answers to the tests, a glossary, what to do when things go wrong, Scout's complete source code, and sources and further reading.
